WITH filtered_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    t.Bytes,
    t.Milliseconds,
    t.UnitPrice,
    m.Name as MediaTypeName
  FROM Track t
  INNER JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(Bytes AS FLOAT) / CAST(Milliseconds AS FLOAT)) as overall_avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM filtered_tracks
),
media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeName,
    AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS FLOAT) / CAST(Milliseconds AS FLOAT)) as avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM filtered_tracks
  GROUP BY MediaTypeName
)
SELECT
  m.MediaTypeName,
  m.avg_price,
  m.avg_bytes_per_ms,
  m.avg_bytes_per_ms / o.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms as ratio
FROM media_type_stats m
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE o.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY m.MediaTypeName
